name: aydy-companion
description: Tracks Claude Code sessions for AYDY and shows how many need you in each window's tab

aydy.autoReopenAsWorkspace.markdownDescription: Reopen a single-folder window as its AYDY workspace file (kept beside the folder, e.g. `~/Code/okven.code-workspace`) as soon as it opens, so its tab can show how many Claude Code sessions need you. A window is never reopened without asking while a Claude Code session in it is working or waiting on you, a terminal in it is running a process, or it has unsaved files.

commands.title: Show Session Count in Tab Title
